testing_attributes_guidelines.rule: Every button, input, link, badge, modal, tab, and status indicator MUST have a clear data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do NOT use dark colors as standard gradients. Keep surfaces crisp with pure white background, subtle dark borders, and rich black accents.
Ensure all copy is in proper, natural Indonesian (Bahasa Indonesia).
Never center-align the main App container globally.
Do NOT use generic emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡 for UI icons. Use Lucide icons (e.g., ShoppingBag, CheckCircle, Copy, Search, Truck, CreditCard, ShieldCheck).
Ensure all interactive elements have responsive micro-interactions (hover, focus-ring, tap scale, loading state).
Ensure input fields carry proper validation and clean accessibility labels.
Ensure header never uses fully transparent background over scrollable content. Use backdrop-blur-md bg-white/90 border-b border-zinc-200.
Ensure Toast notifications use sonner for all actions (e.g. 'Pesanan Berhasil Dibuat', 'Nomor Rekening Disalin', 'Keranjang Diperbarui').
